description: NEET misconception taxonomy. Each entry is a canonical misconception referenced by tag from item_bank misconception_tags fields.

entry_shape.tag: short-kebab-case-slug, referenced from item_bank misconception_tags values
entry_shape.concept_tag: which concept this misconception belongs to
entry_shape.related_item_ids: array of item ids where this misconception shows up as a wrong-option tag
